title: Sean Payton cautions against judging short-yardage play calls

sources.title: Sean Payton cautions against judging short-yardage play calls
sources.description: It has been an up and down start to Davis Webb’s career as an offensive coordinator as the Denver Broncos offense has been completely defunct for large stretches of games in each of the first three games. Some of the more perplexing calls have come in short-yardage situations, which was something head coach Sean Payton […]
